contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CONSTAN-TINVS AVG ; R/ BEATA TRANQVILLITAS // VOTIS XX

A Roman copper-alloy nummus of Constantine I (AD 307-337) dating to AD 321. BEATA TRANQVILLITAS // VOTIS XX Reverse type with an altar, which has a globe, on top. Mint Trier. Reece period 16. Sear 16173. Obverse description: Helmeted, cuirassed bust right. Obverse inscription: CONSTAN-TINVS AVG. Reverse description: Globe on top of altar, three stars above, VOTIS XX inscribed inside.
